thread:
carmen: New hire ran through the audio-transcribe sample and hit multiple copy/paste problems in the README.
rahul: what happened?
carmen: curl example uses OLD_KEY and posts to /realtime/stream -> 404. TS sample shows `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` (wrong pkg) and the retry snippet uses `retryAttempts: 3` which implies parity with Python.
ivy: oof. we moved to @redwood-inference/sdk and renamed env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY months ago. also JS client uses jittered exponential backoff by default, Python has a different default backoff strategy. we should avoid claiming parity.
carmen: i'm going to open a small PR: fix curl env + url, update TS import to `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'`, and add a note: "Retry defaults differ per SDK; see /docs/retries.md". will also swap node-fetch -> undici in sample package.json and set "type":"module".
rahul: please also fix the README link that points to ./examples/realtime/index.ts — that file was moved to ./examples/realtime/src/index.ts. link checker should have caught that.
carmen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/5011 — "fix(samples): update audio-transcribe README imports, links, and retry note"
docs-bot: PR opened by carmen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/5011 :eyes:
ivy: tiny nit: format the code block with ```ts so GitHub highlights it.
carmen: done in PR. added a short troubleshooting section: "If you see 401s verify REDWOOD_API_KEY and region endpoint (see /docs/regions.md)."
rahul: can we add a non-blocking smoke job in samples CI that runs `npm ci && node ./examples/realtime/dist/index.mjs`? that would have caught the node-fetch/esm mismatch.
carmen: added a samples-smoke workflow in the PR as non-blocking. also added CONTRIBUTING.md checklist entry: "run local sample smoke and verify example imports/ENV names/links".
build-bot: link-checker: broken link found in README -> ./examples/realtime/index.ts (reported 2026-05-02T09:44:11Z)
ivy: thanks for moving quickly. i'll file a small issue to track cross-SDK retry docs so we can include a table of defaults: #1104.
rahul: ok assigning to eng-docs for Q2. merge once CI is green. :white_check_mark:
